meta.title: NMB Team Developer Hub
meta.description: Explore NMB Team's open-source projects, developer guides, and runnable examples.

title: Developer documentation
intro: Explore the tools we build for Haxe developers. Find a project, follow a guide, or open the source and see how it works.

limen.description: Open native windows, handle input, and render with OpenGL, Vulkan, or Direct3D. Start with a window and work up to a playable 2D game.

hashlink.description: Our fork of the HashLink virtual machine for Haxe. Learn how to build the runtime and manage its installation and optional LIMEN modules.

heaps.description: Our fork of Heaps, a Haxe framework for 2D and 3D games. Explore the samples to see how scenes, rendering, and shaders fit together.

imgui.description: Dear ImGui integration for Heaps. Use it to build debug panels, editors, and in-game tools in Haxe.
